name: 药理学与靶点开发预设
description: 专注于药物分子、成药靶点、药理作用机制(MoA)与临床适应症评估的分类体系。
en_description: Ontology focused on druggable targets, small-molecule therapeutics, biologics, PROTAC degraders, and indications.

Druggable_Target.name: 成药靶点蛋白 / 受体
Druggable_Target.label: 成药靶点蛋白 / 受体
Druggable_Target.description: 激酶、GPCR、核受体、离子通道等具备调控潜力的生物靶标
Druggable_Target.en_description: Kinases, GPCRs, nuclear receptors, ion channels, or disease-modifying biological targets.

Small_Molecule_Drug.name: 小分子化学药物 / 先导物
Small_Molecule_Drug.label: 小分子化学药物 / 先导物
Small_Molecule_Drug.description: 小分子抑制剂、激动剂、变构调节剂或前体化合物
Small_Molecule_Drug.en_description: Synthetic small-molecule inhibitors, agonists, allosteric modulators, or prodrugs.
patterns: ^(?:gefitinib|erlotinib|osimertinib|imatinib|dasatinib|sunitinib|sorafenib|regorafenib|vemurafenib|dabrafenib|alpelisib|palbociclib|ribociclib|abemaciclib|olaparib|rucaparib|niraparib|ibrutinib|venetoclax|sotorasib|adagrasib|bortezomib|carfilzomib|simvastatin|atorvastatin|rosuvastatin|omeprazole|metformin|aspirin|paclitaxel|doxorubicin|cisplatin|吉非替尼|伊马替尼|奥希替尼|索拉非尼|他汀|阿司匹林|紫杉醇|顺铂)$

Biologics_ADC.name: 生物制品 / 单抗 / ADC
Biologics_ADC.label: 生物制品 / 单抗 / ADC
Biologics_ADC.description: 治疗性单抗、抗体偶联药物(ADC)、重组细胞因子或融合蛋白
Biologics_ADC.en_description: Therapeutic monoclonal antibodies, antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs), or recombinant proteins.
patterns: ^(?:trastuzumab|pertuzumab|pembrolizumab|nivolumab|atezolizumab|durvalumab|rituximab|cetuximab|bevacizumab|panitumumab|ipilimumab|adalimumab|infliximab|etanercept|aflibercept|trastuzumab emtansine|t-dm1|trastuzumab deruxtecan|t-dxd|brentuximab vedotin|enfortumab vedotin|sacituzumab govitecan|曲妥珠单抗|帕博利珠单抗|纳武利尤单抗|利妥昔单抗|贝伐珠单抗|阿达木单抗)$

PROTAC_Degrader.name: 靶向蛋白降解剂 / PROTAC
PROTAC_Degrader.label: 靶向蛋白降解剂 / PROTAC
PROTAC_Degrader.description: 蛋白降解靶向嵌合体(PROTAC)、分子胶或靶向自噬降解嵌合体
PROTAC_Degrader.en_description: Proteolysis-targeting chimeras (PROTACs), molecular glues, or targeted degraders.
patterns: ^(?:thalidomide|lenalidomide|pomalidomide|arv-110|arv-471|arv110|arv471|bavendit|vhl|cereblon|crbn|沙利度胺|来那度胺|泊马度胺)$

Disease_Indication.name: 临床适应症 / 疾病模型
Disease_Indication.label: 临床适应症 / 疾病模型
Disease_Indication.description: 肿瘤适应症、神经退行性疾病、代谢病或动物造模表型
Disease_Indication.en_description: Oncological indications, neurodegenerative diseases, metabolic syndromes, or animal models.
patterns: .*(?:癌|肉瘤|白血病|淋巴瘤|综合征|病|适应症)$
^(?:nsclc|sclc|crc|hcc|rcc|pdac|tnbc|aml|cml|cll|breast cancer|lung cancer|colorectal cancer|melanoma|glioblastoma|alzheimer|parkinson|diabetes|hypertension|asthma|肺癌|乳腺癌|结直肠癌|黑色素瘤|白血病|非小细胞肺癌)$

Biomarker_Resistant_Mutation.name: 疗效标志物 / 耐药突变
Biomarker_Resistant_Mutation.label: 疗效标志物 / 耐药突变
Biomarker_Resistant_Mutation.description: 预后/伴随诊断标志物、靶向药获得性耐药突变位点
Biomarker_Resistant_Mutation.en_description: Prognostic/companion biomarkers or acquired drug-resistance mutation sites.
patterns: .*(?:耐药突变|突变位点|伴随诊断)$

Uncertain.name: 无法判断 / 未定
Uncertain.label: 无法判断 / 未定
Uncertain.description: 无法归类或证据不足的药物实体概念

Target_Binding_Inhibition.name: 靶向结合 / 变构抑制
Target_Binding_Inhibition.label: 靶向结合 / 变构抑制
Target_Binding_Inhibition.description: 小分子或抗体特异性结合靶标并产生抑制效应
Target_Binding_Inhibition.en_description: Specific drug-target binding resulting in functional inhibition.

Target_Activation_Agonism.name: 激动 / 受体激活
Target_Activation_Agonism.label: 激动 / 受体激活
Target_Activation_Agonism.description: 配体结合促使受体构象改变并开启下游信号

Targeted_Degradation.name: 靶向降解 / 泛素化清除
Targeted_Degradation.label: 靶向降解 / 泛素化清除
Targeted_Degradation.description: PROTAC诱导靶蛋白三元复合物形成与蛋白酶体降解
Targeted_Degradation.en_description: Degrader-induced ternary complex formation and proteasomal degradation.

Clinical_Sensitivity.name: 治疗响应 / 敏感性
Clinical_Sensitivity.label: 治疗响应 / 敏感性
Clinical_Sensitivity.description: 生物标志物阳性人群对靶向治疗显现客观缓解
Clinical_Sensitivity.en_description: Favorable therapeutic response in biomarker-positive cohort.

Acquired_Resistance.name: 继发耐药 / 旁路激活
Acquired_Resistance.label: 继发耐药 / 旁路激活
Acquired_Resistance.description: 突变位点产生导致药物亲和力骤降或旁路代偿激活
Acquired_Resistance.en_description: Secondary mutation causing drug affinity loss or compensatory bypass.

Adverse_Reaction_Toxicity.name: 不良反应 / 脱靶毒性
Adverse_Reaction_Toxicity.label: 不良反应 / 脱靶毒性
Adverse_Reaction_Toxicity.description: 在正常组织产生的脱靶毒性、免疫相关不良事件(irAE)
Adverse_Reaction_Toxicity.en_description: Off-target toxicity or immune-related adverse events (irAEs).
